# ============================================================
# Consulta Oracle BCT que se esta ejecutando (findPuntosCesByTickets)
# Origen: TRX_HDR (BCT) + sw_cem.TRX_POINTS + sw_cem.trx_points_ext
# Filtros: TRANSACTIONTYPE='sale', IDENTIFICATIONNUMBER LIKE '1000%' (LEN=10), POINTS!=0
# ============================================================

select
    hdr.NUM_TRX                                ticket
,   TO_CHAR(hdr.FECHA_TRX,'YYYY-MM-DD')        fechaVenta
,   hdr.NUM_TIENDA                             tienda
,   hdr.TIPO_TRX                               tipoTransaccion
,   hdr.MNT_TOTAL_A_PAGAR                      montoVenta
,   hdr.MNT_TOT_SN_IMPTOS                      montoSinImpuestos
,   hdr.MNT_REDONDEO                           montoRedondeo
,   SUM(((SELECT distinct ext.f_conv FROM SW_CEM.trx_points_ext ext WHERE ext.id = p.ID) * TO_NUMBER(p.POINTS))) montoPuntos
,   p.ID                                       idPuntos
,   p.TRANSACTIONTYPE                          tipoTransaccionCes
,   p.POINTS                                   puntos
from  TRX_HDR hdr
    , sw_cem.TRX_POINTS p
where (TO_CHAR("DATE",'YYYYMMDD') || p.BRANCH || lpad(p.POS, 3, '0') || lpad(p.SEQUENCE, 4, '0')) = hdr.NUM_TRX
AND   hdr.NUM_TRX IN (

group by hdr.NUM_TRX, hdr.FECHA_TRX, hdr.NUM_TIENDA, hdr.TIPO_TRX, hdr.MNT_TOTAL_A_PAGAR,

# ============================================================
# Diagnostico — si la consulta principal no devuelve filas, ejecutar paso a paso:
# ============================================================

# 1) Existen los tickets en TRX_HDR?
SELECT NUM_TRX, FECHA_TRX, NUM_TIENDA, TIPO_TRX
  FROM TRX_HDR
 WHERE NUM_TRX IN ('2025121820380039279','2025121820300054032','2025021610500084148','2025031010300076595' /* ...resto */ );

# 2) Existen TRX_POINTS para esos tickets (sin filtros de tipo/identificacion)?
SELECT p.*
  FROM sw_cem.TRX_POINTS p, TRX_HDR hdr
 WHERE (TO_CHAR("DATE",'YYYYMMDD') || p.BRANCH || lpad(p.POS,3,'0') || lpad(p.SEQUENCE,4,'0')) = hdr.NUM_TRX
   AND hdr.NUM_TRX IN ('2025121820380039279','2025121820300054032' /* ...resto */ );

# 3) Cuales TRANSACTIONTYPE tienen?  (tal vez no son 'sale')
SELECT p.TRANSACTIONTYPE, COUNT(*)
  FROM sw_cem.TRX_POINTS p, TRX_HDR hdr
 WHERE (TO_CHAR("DATE",'YYYYMMDD') || p.BRANCH || lpad(p.POS,3,'0') || lpad(p.SEQUENCE,4,'0')) = hdr.NUM_TRX
   AND hdr.NUM_TRX IN ('2025121820380039279','2025121820300054032' /* ...resto */ )
 GROUP BY p.TRANSACTIONTYPE;

# 4) IDENTIFICATIONNUMBER cumple LIKE '1000%' AND LENGTH=10?
SELECT p.IDENTIFICATIONNUMBER, LENGTH(p.IDENTIFICATIONNUMBER), p.POINTS, p.TRANSACTIONTYPE
  FROM sw_cem.TRX_POINTS p, TRX_HDR hdr
 WHERE (TO_CHAR("DATE",'YYYYMMDD') || p.BRANCH || lpad(p.POS,3,'0') || lpad(p.SEQUENCE,4,'0')) = hdr.NUM_TRX
   AND hdr.NUM_TRX IN ('2025121820380039279','2025121820300054032' /* ...resto */ );
